scenarios.title: A｜房间已经准备好
scenarios.setting: 你比正常入住时间提前两个小时到达酒店，准备询问是否可以提前办理入住。
learningGoals: I know I’m a little early.
Is there any chance I could check in early?

turns.text: Good morning. Welcome! How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你提前到达酒店，会怎样说明情况并询问入住？

choices.text: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Chen. I know I’m a little early.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Chen. I know I’m a little early.
feedback.explanation: “under the name”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Hi, I have a reservation for tonight. Is there any chance I could check in early?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I have a reservation for tonight. Is there any chance I could check in early?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I arrived earlier than expected. I was wondering if my room might be ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: I arrived earlier than expected. I was wondering if my room might be ready.
feedback.explanation: “I arrived”说明已经到达的时间或方式，便于核对行程记录。

choices.text: My check-in isn’t until three, but could you see if the room is available yet?

feedback.naturalExpression: My check-in isn’t until three, but could you see if the room is available yet?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Can I check in more early?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check in early?
feedback.explanation: “early”的比较级是“earlier”，不说“more early”；提前入住也可直接说“check in early”。

turns.text: Let me check for you. Could I see your ID, please?

turns.prompt: 前台请你出示证件，你会怎样回应？

choices.text: Sure. Here you go.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Here you go.
feedback.explanation: “here you go”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Of course. Here it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Here it is.
feedback.explanation: “here it is”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

turns.text: Good news—your room is already ready, so we can check you in now.

turns.prompt: 房间已经准备好，你想回应这个消息并表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s great, thank you!

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s great, thank you!
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

choices.text: Great! Is there any extra charge for checking in early?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great! Is there any extra charge for checking in early?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

turns.text: No, there’s no extra charge today.

turns.prompt: 确认无需额外付费后，你会怎样结束这段交流？

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. That’s really helpful.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. That’s really helpful.
feedback.explanation: “really helpful”明确表示信息或帮助有用，让对方知道这次回应解决了需要。

scenarios.title: B｜房间还没准备好
scenarios.setting: 你提前到达酒店，但房间还没有准备好。你需要确认大概的等待时间和可以等候的地方。
learningGoals: How long do you think it’ll be?

turns.text: I’m sorry, but your room isn’t ready yet. Check-in officially starts at three.

turns.prompt: 房间还没有准备好，你会怎样询问等待时间？

choices.text: No problem. Do you know roughly when it’ll be ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Do you know roughly when it’ll be ready?
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: That’s okay. How long do you think it’ll be?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. How long do you think it’ll be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: I understand. Is there any chance it’ll be ready before three?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Is there any chance it’ll be ready before three?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Okay. Could you let me know when the room is ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you let me know when the room is ready?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: When my room can be ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will my room be ready?
feedback.explanation: 直接问句要把情态动词放到主语前；预计房间何时准备好，常问“When will my room be ready?”。

turns.text: Housekeeping is working on it now. It should be ready around two.

turns.prompt: 得知房间的预计准备时间，你想确认等待或返回的安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, that’s not too long.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that’s not too long.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Great. I’ll come back around two, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll come back around two, then.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Sounds good. Is there somewhere I can wait in the meantime?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. Is there somewhere I can wait in the meantime?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Of course. You’re welcome to wait in the lobby or use the café downstairs.

turns.prompt: 前台提供了等候地点，你想回应建议并说明自己的打算，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thanks. I’ll wait downstairs.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks. I’ll wait downstairs.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll grab something to eat while I wait.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll grab something to eat while I wait.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜寄存行李后稍后回来
scenarios.setting: 你的房间还要几小时才能准备好。你准备先把行李寄存在酒店，外出后再回来。

turns.text: Unfortunately, your room won’t be ready for another couple of hours.

turns.prompt: 你想寄存行李并稍后回来，会怎样询问？

choices.text: That’s fine. Could I leave my luggage here and come back later?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Could I leave my luggage here and come back later?
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

choices.text: No problem. Can you store my bags until the room is ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Can you store my bags until the room is ready?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: That’s okay. Is there somewhere I can leave my luggage?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Is there somewhere I can leave my luggage?
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

choices.text: Could you hold my bags for me while I go out for a while?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you hold my bags for me while I go out for a while?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can I put my luggage here first?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I leave my luggage here?
feedback.explanation: 意思能够理解，但在酒店寄存行李时，leave my luggage 或 store my luggage 更自然、更准确。

turns.text: Absolutely. We can store your bags for you.

turns.prompt: 酒店可以寄存行李，你会怎样确认手续？

choices.text: Great. Do I need to fill anything out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do I need to fill anything out?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Thanks. Do I need a tag or a receipt?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Do I need a tag or a receipt?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll leave these two bags with you, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll leave these two bags with you, then.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: I’ll give you a luggage tag. Just bring this back when you return.

turns.prompt: 你拿到了行李牌，想确认后续取行李的安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. What time should I come back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. What time should I come back?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll keep it with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll keep it with me.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. I’ll come back after three.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll come back after three.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: Anytime after three should be fine.

turns.prompt: 确认返回时间后，你会怎样结束交流？

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great. See you later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. See you later.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。
